description_en: Queries a list of deployment packages
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-deployment-packages --project-identifier dw_project --project-id 10003 --creator 1107550004250000 --end-create-time 1593877765000 --executor 20030000 --end-execute-time 1593877765000 --status 1 --keyword abc --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDeploymentPackages

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the DataWorks workspace, which is the identifier at the top of the Data Studio page where you switch workspaces. Either this parameter or ProjectId must be specified to determine which DataWorks workspace this API call operates on
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的唯一标识符，
即数据开发页面顶部切换工作空间处的英文标识。该参数与ProjectId参数二者必须设置其一，以确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the workspace configuration page to query the ID. You must configure either this parameter or the ProjectIdentifier parameter to determine the DataWorks workspace to which the operation is applied
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。
您可以登录DataWorks管控台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。该参数与ProjectIdentifier参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the deployment package creator
parameters.help_zh: 发布包创建者的阿里云账号UID
parameters.name: creator

parameters.help_en: The maximum millisecond timestamp for when the deployment package was created
parameters.help_zh:
生成发布包的
最大毫秒时间戳
parameters.name: end_create_time

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the deployment package executor
parameters.help_zh: 发布包执行者的阿里云账号UID
parameters.name: executor

parameters.help_en: The maximum millisecond timestamp for when the deployment package started executing
parameters.help_zh:
发布包开始执行的
最大毫秒时间戳
parameters.name: end_execute_time

parameters.help_en:
The status of the deployment package. Valid values:

- 0: It is ready.

- 1: It was successfully deployed.

- 2: It failed to be deployed.

- 6: It was rejected
parameters.help_zh:
发布包当前的状态。取值如下：
- 0：发布包已准备就绪。
- 1：发布包发布成功。
- 2：发布包发布失败。
- 6：发布包被驳回
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The keyword in the deployment package name. DataWorks supports fuzzy matching, meaning you can enter a keyword to query for deployment packages that contain it
parameters.help_zh:
发布包名称的关键字。
DataWorks支持模糊匹配，即输入关键字，即可查询包含该关键字的发布包
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
每页显示的条数，默认为10条，
最大100条
parameters.name: page_size
